description: Use when the user asks to compare two Steam players, whether two accounts are related or share friends, or for smurf and alt-account hints: identity, account age, visibility, Steam bans, FACEIT and shared friends compared over the full friend lists. HEAVIEST tool - it builds two summaries plus both friend graphs. Do not use for a single player (steam_summary) or for more than two players (steam_batch).

id1.description: any SteamID format: steamid64 (17 digits), STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id, a steamcommunity.com link or a vanity name

id2.description: any SteamID format: steamid64 (17 digits), STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id, a steamcommunity.com link or a vanity name

name: steam_compare

a.description: summary of the first player: identity, account, Steam bans, FACEIT

shared_friends.description: friends present in both snapshots; an empty list is not proof the players are unrelated

title: Compare two players
